elements.label: Figure 2.1: Ageing Vietnam
elements.description: Grouped bar chart. Y-axis: '# of households (in millions)', scale 0–8. X-axis: age categories of the oldest household member: 10–19, 20–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60–69, 70+. Legend: 2010 (teal), 2020 (orange). Values printed on bars: 2010 = 0.1, 1.5, 4.7, 6.2, 5.1, 2.5, 2.2; 2020 = 0.0, 1.2, 5.1, 6.7, 6.4, 4.6, 2.7. Note: Categories are by the oldest member of the household. Source: World Bank staff calculations using the VHLSS, 2010-2020. Pattern: the number of households with older heads rises across the decade, with the 2020 bars higher than 2010 in the 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60–69 and 70+ groups, while the younger groups are smaller or flat.
